visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS - Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. 1px subtle borders on right and bottom of panes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-none (minimal flat technical UI) or very subtle ambient shadows for popovers.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800. No rounded corners heavily. Keep it max rounded-md (6px) to rounded-lg (8px) for inputs and buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating settings dialogs or dropdowns. backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80.

layouts.main_structure: 100vh h-screen w-full flex flex-col bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden.
layouts.header: h-14 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between px-4 bg-zinc-950 shrink-0.
layouts.left_panel: flex-1 flex flex-col border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 relative overflow-hidden.
layouts.preview_header: h-12 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center px-4 bg-zinc-900/50 gap-2 shrink-0.

components.browser_chrome: A mock browser header for the left preview pane. Contains URL bar (read-only, centered), and device toggles (Desktop/Tablet/Mobile).
components.tabs: Used to switch between 'Preview', 'HTML', 'CSS', 'JS' in the left pane. Use clean underline or solid minimal style.
components.chat_message: User: Right aligned or distinct bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-3. AI: Markdown rendered, transparent background, distinct avatar.
components.prompt_input: Textarea that auto-resizes, minimal border (border-zinc-700 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500/50), solid send button.
components.model_selector: Shadcn select dropdown in the header.
components.settings_dialog: Shadcn Dialog for API keys management. Inputs for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Qwen.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons (bg-zinc-800 to bg-zinc-700), subtle scale down on click.
motion.loading: Use a subtle pulsing skeleton or typing indicator for AI response.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a split-screen AI website builder with React/Tailwind/Shadcn.
Implement an IDE-like interface: clean, dark (bg-zinc-950), dense.
Use Shadcn components heavily: button, input, textarea, select, dialog, tabs.
Do not use generic generic 'Inter' for everything; use 'IBM Plex Sans' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for code.
Ensure the split layout fills 100vh completely without page scrolling. Scroll should only happen within the chat history and code view.
Create a mock browser wrapper for the live preview.
Create state management (React Context or Zustand if needed, or just standard React state) for chat history, preview code (HTML/CSS/JS), and selected device preview mode.
Implement the Settings Dialog that stores API keys securely in localStorage.
For Code rendering, use a code highlighting library if possible, or simple pre/code tags with JetBrains Mono font.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do not center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
